title: Python: Modules and Packages
description: Write a Python program demonstrating how to import and use standard library modules.

codeTemplate.py:
import math
import random
from datetime import datetime
from statistics import mean, median, stdev

print(f"Pi: {math.pi:.4f}")
print(f"Sin(90°): {math.sin(math.radians(90))}")

print(f"Random 1-10: {random.randint(1, 10)}")

now = datetime.now()
print(f"Current: {now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")

data = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
print(f"Mean: {mean(data)}")
print(f"Median: {median(data)}")
